description: Django REST Framework viewsets for managing courses, modules, lessons, enrollments, quizzes, questions, choices, quiz attempts, certificates, learning paths, notifications, and reporting endpoints in a corporate learning management platform.

classes.name: CourseViewSet
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations and publishing for courses, including notifications to enrolled users upon publishing.

classes.name: LessonViewSet
classes.description: Manages lessons, including marking lessons as completed and updating course progress and certificates.

classes.name: EnrollmentViewSet
classes.description: Handles user enrollments in courses, with role-based access control.

classes.name: QuizViewSet
classes.description: Manages quizzes associated with courses and lessons.

classes.name: QuizAttemptViewSet
classes.description: Handles creation and completion of quiz attempts, with role-based filtering.

classes.name: LearningPathViewSet
classes.description: Manages learning paths and their items.

classes.name: NotificationViewSet
classes.description: Lists notifications for users and allows marking them as read.

classes.name: ReportingViewSet
classes.description: Provides aggregated reporting data for managers and admins.

methods.name: audit
methods.description: Logs audit entries for user actions.

methods.name: notify_user
methods.description: Sends notifications to users via channels.
